full_judgment: 10. The landlords who filed the suit for eviction in 1940 stated in the plaint Ext. 3 that the two brothers Raj Kumar and Surya Kumar obtained monthly tenancy of the suit land from Baisakh 1341 B.S. on a monthly rent of Tk. 2'50. The tenancy, therefore, started in 1934. The suit for eviction was filed in 1940. The decree, however, was passed on 5.9.50. The landlords did not press the prayer for khas possession of the suit land. The suit was de-creed for Tk. 22'50 being rent of the-'suit land from Sravana to Chaitra of 1346 B.S. at the rate of Tk. 2.50 per month.
